title: 全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师_柠蓝浅夏_第2章 才过去半天时间！
content_zh:
负重栏内出现“普通酒水”的字样瞬间，许默迫不及待地选择了饮用，与此同时，他原本已经归零的饱腹值，终于上涨了10点。

【饱腹：10/150】

虽然只有不起眼的10点，但生命值总算是没有继续降低了。

“妈的……”

感受着稍稍减弱的饥饿感，许默有些如释重负的躺在草地上，他赌对了，酒的确能恢复饱腹值，虽然微乎其微，但关键时候能救命。

劫后余生的许默，并没有过于庆幸。

10点饱腹值，支撑不了多久，危机并没有彻底解除。

稍作休息，他感觉体力值恢复的差不多了，又重新起身，继续开始在四周寻找起鸟粪来。

终于，水潭四周的鸟粪被搜刮的一干二净，按照比例酿造制作酒水后，他终于将饱腹值恢复到了100点以上。

除此外，负重栏内还剩下“普通酒水”X5。

没有一口气喝完，是因为他发现自己制作的酒水，除了能恢复10点饱腹值外，还能额外恢复30点干渴值。

刚才经过一番操作，干渴值已经到上限了，再喝就有点浪费了。

好消息，食物危机暂时解除了。

坏消息，周围能制作食物的资源，彻底用光了，许默必须转移探寻其他地方。

他先是收集储存了足够多的水，单个负重栏的上限是“水X10”，他足足装了10栏，负重变成了13/15。

准备完毕后，他重新踏进了迷雾。

又走了一段路程后，周围的环境出现了变化，弥漫的雾气中开始出现零星的树木，大都形状怪诞，地面上偶尔也会出现鲜艳的花朵和更多的鸟粪。

虽然依旧静谧，但至少多了几分生气，没有此前那么压抑了。

许默没有闲着，尽可能地将鸟粪内的种子都收集起来，然后配合水全部制作成酒水，很快就塞满了整整两个负重栏。

这时候，许默忽然注意到，远处的草地竟生长着一株蓝色的植物。

“蘑菇！”

这是他探索了这么久以来，发现的唯一或许能够食用的东西，尽管对方造型扭曲，而且浑身散发着诡异的蓝色。

许默思索片刻后，打开【频道】。

【当前区域编号：9527幸存人数：6213】

相较于刚开始，里面的人数少了许多，大多数人应该都意识到了，面板上的任何一个属性值，都不是闹着玩的。

【编号65864156：有没有好心人说一声，哪里能找到吃的？我快饿死了。】

【编号03264861：干渴值归零后扣生命值？怎么办，我到现在一口水都没找到，我不想死！】

【编号65891435：哈哈！我这森林里面有不少浆果，吃不完根本吃不完……嗝！有人要交易吗？拿东西来换！】

【编号24624626：温馨提示，如果遇到“浆果”、“蓝蘑菇”、“花”请放心食用，亲测有效，可恢复不同程度的饱腹值。】

没记错的话，此前他所在区域的人数应该是七千多吧？

“人数减少了……”

看样子，除了部分食物丰富的地区，大多数人都遇到了同样的问题，许默又翻了一下，见不少人确认蓝蘑菇可以食用，才放心上前采摘。

【获得“蓝蘑菇”X1】

接下来，许默再次遇到蓝蘑菇，都会将其收入囊中，期间他尝试吃了一个，发现饱腹值上涨了25点，效果似乎还算不错。

【获得蓝蘑菇X7】

【负重：15/15】

采集完成后，许默的负重栏也彻底满了，可这时候，他却注意到一个不对劲的地方。

原本装了十个负重栏的“水”X10，此刻变成了“不干净的水”X10，最早采集来的“蓝蘑菇”，也变成了“不新鲜的蓝蘑菇”。

“什么情况？”

许默眉头拧成了一个川字，收集来的水和食物会随着时间变质，可是这也太快了吧！

才过去半天时间！

许默不知道“不干净的水”和“不新鲜的蓝蘑菇”食用后会有什么负面影响，但这么看来，他储存的水和食物，根本无法长久保存。

“加速腐败，也是世界规则的一部分吗？”

让许默意外的是，他制作的“酒水”却并没有发生变化，许默松了口气，又莫名庆幸起来，“倒也符合常识。”

目前看来，他的天赋远比他想象的更加有用！

为了防止水继续变质，他这次没有保留，将搜集来的所有种子配合水，全部制作成了酒水。

以防万一，许默没有都留着，他拿出一部分，放在了交易所内。

所谓的【交易】有两种模式，一种是以物易物，另一种则是消耗幸存点数购买，界面最下方，显示着许默的当前幸存点数：10。

每个人的初始幸存点数都是一样的，而且会随着幸存时间而获得。

交易行内的交易数量不算多，挂上去的也大都是草、树杈、石块等常见物资，至于水、食物的需求量虽大，但价格却高得离谱。

一单位水，竟然被挂出了5个幸存点的高价。

思索再三后，许默每单位酒水挂出了10个幸存点。

毕竟他制作的酒水，不仅仅能提升干渴值，饱腹值，甚至还能当做长期保存的食物，非常少见。

做完这些后，他关掉了交易行。

周围的光线逐渐变的泛黄昏暗，加上雾气的弥漫，能见度再次降低，许默虽然无法判断具体时间，但也能感受到夜晚就要降临了。

本能的警惕，让他立刻站起身来，打开【制作】栏后选中了【简易火把】。

【简易火把】

【制作需求：干草X5，树枝X2】

选择【制作】后，负重栏内，顿时多了“简易火把（可装备）”X1的字样。

随着时间推移，周围的光线越发阴暗，原本的白雾也因为能见度原因，变成了漆黑的墨色，就在这时，一种前所未有的危机感猛地在脑海中浮现。

黑暗中，好似有无数双眼睛正在窥伺，垂涎的望着他。

许默装备上火把，火光照亮的瞬间，周围的黑暗如潮水般散开，那种恐惧感也随之消散，这时候许默才发现，就在刚刚短短的几分钟内，他的理智值就猛掉了一截。

【理智：102/150】

而且，随着夜幕降临后，这个数字依旧在缓慢且持续的降低着。

不知何时，周围已经变成了漆黑一片，许默有些后怕的靠在树干上坐了下来，盯着周围的黑雾，许默总感觉里面藏着什么东西，不安的感觉使得他起了一身鸡皮疙瘩。

理智掉的更快了。

【理智：98/150】

“不行！不能再看周围了。”为了转移注意力，许默打开了聊天频道，点开的瞬间，他瞳孔猛地一缩。

【当前区域编号：9527幸存人数：3562】

content_en:
The moment the words "ordinary drinks" appeared in the weight column, Xu Mo couldn't wait to drink. At the same time, his satiety value, which had already returned to zero, finally increased by 10 points.

【Fullness: 10/150】

Although it was only an inconspicuous 10 points, the health value finally did not continue to decrease.

"Damn..."

Feeling the slightly weakened hunger, Xu Mo lay down on the grass with some relief. He had made the right bet. Wine could indeed restore the satiety value. Although it was very small, it could save lives at critical times.

Xu Mo, who survived the disaster, was not overly grateful.

The satiety value of 10 points cannot be sustained for long, and the crisis has not been completely resolved.

After taking a short rest, he felt that his physical strength had almost recovered, so he stood up again and continued to look for bird droppings around him.

Finally, all the bird droppings around the pond were plundered, and after brewing the wine according to the proportion, he finally restored the satiety value to over 100 points.

In addition, there are "ordinary drinks" x5 left in the load column.

He didn't drink it all in one go because he found that the wine he made could not only restore 10 satiety points, but also restore an additional 30 thirst points.

After some operations just now, the thirst level has reached the upper limit, and drinking anymore will be a bit wasteful.

Good news, the food crisis is temporarily over.

Bad news, the surrounding resources for making food have been completely used up, Xu Mo must move and explore other places.

He first collected and stored enough water. The upper limit of a single load-bearing column was "water x 10". He filled 10 columns, and the load became 13/15.

After making preparations, he stepped into the fog again.

After walking for a while, the surrounding environment changed. Scattered trees began to appear in the diffuse fog, most of them with weird shapes. Occasionally, bright flowers and more bird droppings appeared on the ground.

Although it was still quiet, it was at least a little more alive and not as depressing as before.

Xu Mo was not idle. He collected as many seeds as possible from the bird droppings and mixed them all with water to make wine. The two load-bearing columns were soon filled.

At this time, Xu Mo suddenly noticed that there was a blue plant growing on the grass in the distance.

"Mushroom!"

This is the only thing he has found that may be edible after exploring for so long, even though it has a twisted shape and a weird blue color all over its body.

After Xu Mo thought for a moment, he opened the [Channel].

[Current area number: 9527 Number of survivors: 6213]

Compared to the beginning, the number of people inside was much smaller, and most people should have realized that any attribute value on the panel was not a joke.

[No. 65864156: Can anyone kindly tell me where I can find food?I'm starving.】

[No. 03264861: Life points will be deducted after the thirst value reaches zero?What should I do? I haven’t found a drop of water yet. I don’t want to die!】

[No. 65891435: Haha!There are so many berries in my forest that I can’t finish them all...burp!Anyone want to trade?Get something in exchange!】

[No. 24624626: Warm reminder, if you encounter "berries", "blue mushrooms", and "flowers", please feel free to eat them. It is effective in personal testing and can restore satiety to varying degrees.】

If I remember correctly, there should have been more than 7,000 people in his area before, right?

"The number of people has decreased..."

It seemed that except for some food-rich areas, most people encountered the same problem. Xu Mo browsed again and saw that many people confirmed that blue mushrooms were edible, so he stepped forward to pick them with confidence.

[Get "Blue Mushroom" X1]

Next, Xu Mo encountered blue mushrooms again and kept them in his pocket. During this period, he tried to eat one and found that the satiety value increased by 25 points. The effect seemed to be pretty good.

[Get Blue Mushroom X7]

[Weight load: 15/15]

After the collection was completed, Xu Mo's weight-bearing column was completely full, but at this time, he noticed something wrong.

The "water" X10 that originally contained ten load-bearing columns has now turned into "dirty water"

"What's going on?"

Xu Mo frowned. The water and food collected would deteriorate over time, but this was too fast!

Only half a day has passed!

Xu Mo didn't know what negative effects the consumption of "dirty water" and "stale blue mushrooms" would have, but it seemed that the water and food he stored could not be stored for a long time.

"Is accelerating corruption part of the rules of the world?"

To Xu Mo's surprise, the "drink" he made did not change. Xu Mo breathed a sigh of relief and felt inexplicably happy, "It's in line with common sense."

At present, it seems that his talent is far more useful than he imagined!

In order to prevent the water from deteriorating further, he did not retain it this time and mixed all the collected seeds with water to make wine.

Just in case, Xu Mo didn't keep them all. He took some of them and put them in the exchange.

The so-called [Transaction] has two modes, one is to barter, and the other is to consume survival points to purchase. At the bottom of the interface, Xu Mo's current survival points are displayed: 10.

Everyone starts with the same number of survival points, which are earned over time.

The number of transactions in the trading house is not large, and most of the items on the shelves are common materials such as grass, tree branches, and stones. Although the demand for water and food is large, the prices are ridiculously high.

A unit of water was actually priced at a high price of 5 survival points.

After thinking over and over again, Xu Mo decided on 10 survival points per unit of drink.

After all, the wine he makes can not only increase thirst and satiety, but can even be used as long-term preserved food, which is very rare.

After doing this, he closed the trading house.

The surrounding light gradually became yellowish and dim, and as the fog spread, the visibility decreased again. Although Xu Mo could not judge the specific time, he could feel that night was coming.

Instinctively alert, he stood up immediately, opened the [Production] column and selected [Simple Torch].

【Simple torch】

[Production requirements: hay x5, branches x2]

After selecting [Create], the words "Simple Torch (Equipable)" X1 suddenly appeared in the load column.

As time went by, the surrounding light became darker and darker, and the original white fog turned into pitch black ink due to visibility reasons. At this moment, an unprecedented sense of crisis suddenly emerged in my mind.

In the darkness, there seemed to be countless pairs of eyes watching, looking at him covetously.

Xu Mo equipped himself with a torch, and the moment the fire illuminated it, the surrounding darkness dispersed like a tide, and the fear also dissipated. Only then did Xu Mo realize that in just a few minutes, his sanity had plummeted.

[Sanity: 102/150]

Moreover, as night falls, this number is still slowly and continuously decreasing.

At some point, the surroundings turned pitch black. Xu Mo sat down against the tree trunk with some fear, staring at the black mist around him. Xu Mo always felt like there was something hidden in it, and the uneasy feeling made his skin crawl.

Losing sanity faster.

[Sanity: 98/150]

"No! You can't look around anymore." In order to divert his attention, Xu Mo opened the chat channel. The moment he clicked on it, his pupils shrank suddenly.

[Current area number: 9527 Number of survivors: 3562]
